item.title: EXMAR awarded FLNG contract for Cedar LNG
item.description: EXMAR has been selected by Cedar LNG Partners LP to provide its marine and operational expertise for the floating LNG unit, megúgu.

item.title: JERA signs LNG supply agreement with QatarEnergy
item.description: JERA Co., Inc. has announced the signing of a long-term LNG sale and purchase agreement with QatarEnergy to secure the supply of 3 million tpy for 27 years.

item.title: Centrica Energy and Seneca Resources Company sign long-term MiQ methane emissions certificates agreement
item.description: Centrica Energy and Seneca Resources Company have announced an agreement to support independently verified methane emissions from an MiQ-certified US natural gas producer.

item.title: Mugardos Energy Terminal ready to supply bio-LNG
item.description: The Mugardos Energy Terminal, owned by the Reganosa Group, now offers a new bio-LNG supply service for ships and tankers.

item.title: NYK concludes long-term charter agreement for new LNG carriers with Cheniere
item.description: NYK Line, in partnership with Ocean Yield AS, has signed multiple long-term charter contracts for new LNG carriers with Cheniere Marketing International LLP.

item.title: Worley selected by Samsung C&T for CO2 sequestration project in Qatar
item.description: Worley Ltd has been awarded a contract by Samsung C&T Corp. to deliver detailed engineering services for the QatarEnergy LNG carbon dioxide sequestration.

item.title: Lloyd’s Register approval clears path for LNG tank design for LNG-fuelled vessels
item.description: Lloyd’s Register has issued an approval in principle for GTT’s CUBIQ LNG fuel containment system, which could widen the use of membrane type LNG fuel tanks into mainstream commercial shipping, including container and cruise ships.

item.title: ORLEN accelerates LNG expansion
item.description: 2025 was a record-breaking year for the LNG segment in Poland, with ORLEN receiving 81 shipments of LNG at the Swinoujscie terminal – up by 20 compared to 2024.

item.title: BBG launches bio-LNG loading service
item.description: The Bahía de Bizkaia Gas LNG storage and regasification plant has obtained the necessary certification to manage bio-LNG in the Port of Bilbao.

item.title: Synergy Marine Group assumes technical management of Yang Ming’s LNG dual-fuel newbuilds
item.description: Synergy Marine Group has taken over the technical management of two 15 500 TEU Class LNG dual-fuel container vessels newly delivered to Yang Ming Marine Transport Corp.
